svg.title: Maximum connected still lifes: proven optima for n=1 through 25
svg.desc: Twenty-five panels. Black squares are live; the gray ring is the dead exterior. Panel 1 is the empty-board convention. All other boards are stable and connected.

g.text: Proven optima for n = 1–25 · black = live · gray ring = dead exterior
